## LIHTC HERA Special test — **Passed**

Tested the live lookup with **Baldwin County, AL · FY2026 · 60% AMI · 3BR** in the UI and directly against the supplied `MTSP-Data-FY26(2).xlsx` source.

| Validation point | Result |
|---|---:|
| Lookup classification | **HERA Special** |
| HERA 60% limit — 4-person | $65,040 annual |
| HERA 60% limit — 5-person | $70,260 annual |
| 3BR imputed household size | 4.5 persons |
| Interpolated annual income limit | **$67,650** |
| Gross monthly LIHTC maximum | **$1,691.25** |

> Calculation: `($65,040 + $70,260) ÷ 2 × 30% ÷ 12 = $1,691.25`

For comparison, the non-HERA regular calculation would have produced **$1,596.00/month**, so the HERA Special path correctly raises the 3BR cap by **$95.25/month**.

I also applied it to a sample unit in the portal:

- **1 × 3BR sample unit**
- Current rent: **$1,500**
- Imported gross LIHTC cap: **$1,691.25**
- Utility allowance: **$150**
- Scenario 1/voucher floor: **$1,400**

Scenario 4 correctly calculated:

> `MAX($1,691.25 − $150, $1,400) = $1,541.25/month`

The interface displayed **$1,541/month** (whole-dollar presentation) and an **annual increase of $495**, which is correct: `($1,541.25 − $1,500) × 12`.

The temporary sandbox test record was cleared afterward. You can run the same lookup in the [GPC Underwriting Control Center Preview](https://8328-i3qt2lykjx2zu5206ntp2-fcd9e5bf.us1.manus.computer/).
